cases.input: Draft and revise a chapter in book two of a planned four-book fantasy series.
requiredBehaviors: create a scene or chapter contract from canon and knowledge state
run workshop before revision and continuity after revision
promote only confirmed facts into canon
forbiddenBehaviors: treat manuscript prose as automatic canon
give a POV character knowledge they do not yet possess
skillAnchors: Workshop vor Revision; Continuity nach Revision

cases.input: Discovery writing produces a better direction that conflicts with the planned outline but not published canon.
requiredBehaviors: update planning and dependent arcs before continuing
forbiddenBehaviors: force the obsolete outline simply because it was planned

cases.input: A revised chapter contains a major continuity contradiction but is promoted into canon anyway.
requiredBehaviors: block canon promotion on major or critical continuity findings
return to revision or canon impact analysis
